# Private CI destinations explicitly approved for source transfers.
# No repositories are approved by default.
# Changes must be reviewed by maintainers and security owners on a protected branch.
# Format: one exact owner/repo@numeric-github-repository-id per active line.
# Example (commented/inert): example-org/private-ci@1412142815
# Reject name-only approvals, whitespace, wildcards, duplicate owners and ID drift.
